prompt: Light 3 on when I press button 1 or button 2, but not both.
note: Extra: both buttons released at the end -> light 3 off, the neither-pushed case the page does not print (C-17). Without it a NAND (light 3 fed through both N.C. contacts in parallel) passes the reference. The expect is copied from III-XOR-PB-DERIVED script[19].

extra.cite: BK3 printed p.41 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.47, stated rule EITHER BUT NOT BOTH (pushbutton 1 = A, pushbutton 2 = B, light 3 = C; either pushed -> light 3 ON, both pushed -> light 3 NOT ON); ER-10 names it EXCLUSIVE OR; derived from topology: neither pushed again at the end of the sequence (C-17, not printed). Arm 2Y returns to 2Z, which is dead with arm 1Y on 1Z; 3A dead, light 3 dark
extra.quote: The program uses the contacts so that if either pushbutton 1 or pushbutton 2 is pushed, light 3 will come ON. Light 3 will NOT come on if both pushbuttons 1 and 2 are pushed.
